name: Ashvale
worldBackground: Ashvale is a small castle on a rise above a farming valley: four towers, a gatehouse, and a keep that has never been taken. The village of Emberwick clusters round its green below the walls, Millfield's farms stretch to the river, and the Whisperwood closes the valley's end. The castellan counts his stores against a hard winter, and the toll he asks of the farms has grown two years running.

currency.name: Silver bit
currency.description: The count's coin, cut silver worn smooth by trade.

narrativeRules: The castle is staffed for a siege no one expects: count the guards, the stores and the leaky roofs.
Villagers owe the castellan toll and tithe both, and say the second was never in any charter.
The Whisperwood gives timber and game to those who ask politely, and takes back its own from those who do not.
Winter is the clock every plan in the valley runs against.

npcs.name: Ser Aldous Marrow
npcs.description: The castellan of Ashvale: exact, sleepless, counting stores against a winter he believes will be cruel. Owes the count a full granary and the village a thinner toll.
npcs.physicalDescription: Grey-cropped soldier in his fifties, ring mail shirt, ledger under one arm

npcs.name: Brenna Ash
npcs.description: The Gilded Stag's keeper: pours honestly, listens closely, repeats selectively. Keeps the village's news and its debts behind the same bar.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tall sharp-eyed woman, apron, ale-soiled towel over one shoulder

npcs.name: Ordwin Cinder
npcs.description: The smith: quiet, exact, sleeps by his forge. Shoes the castle's horses at half price and keeps a ledger of who owes him what.
npcs.physicalDescription: Bare-armed smith with burn-scarred forearms, leather apron, soot in his beard

npcs.name: Tilla Reed
npcs.description: The tenant of Millfield: works her strips hard and reads the castellan's toll notices twice. Wants the toll in writing or not at all.
npcs.physicalDescription: Weathered woman in a patched coat, tally slate on a thong round her neck

npcs.name: Hale Millrace
npcs.description: The miller: keeps the leat clear and his thumb on the scale, in that order. The village forgives the second because of the first.
npcs.physicalDescription: Flour-dusted man, rolled sleeves, weighted paddle in hand
